verified_uncited_book_records.text: The entry headed 唱 gives chàng and rhyme-category information, then calls 唱 a phonosemantic graph: 从口，昌声. It says the oracle-bone graph 昌 was originally 日 plus 口 and identifies it as “唱”之初文; 唱 was formed by adding 口 to 昌. It proposes that the original referent was a call at sunrise to summon people to work, likely often tuneful, and describes this as a source of singing. It then says the sense extended to leading a song, quotes Shuowen 導也, and reports that older texts often wrote 倡 for 唱 before the graphs differentiated. These are the book author's proposals and account, not independently demonstrated graphic chronology. The occurrence and paragraph are visible under the 唱 heading; the next entry is 和, not a continuation of the 唱 passage. The printed page number 83 is visible at the bottom.
